clips.title: The story
paras: Duskbats circle Deathknell, and local tailors turn their wings into makeshift armor for newly risen soldiers.

New Forsaken claw from Deathknell’s soil with little more than rags and brittle bones. With mindless Scourge and hostile wildlife nearby, they must gather what protection they can. Novice Elreth, assistant to Shadow Priest Sarvis, collects Duskbat Wings and wolf paws to piece together and strengthen clothing and armor for freshly raised warriors before they enter the wilderness to fight.
